rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, temporary capital improvement and substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay tenants relocation amounts based on when the eviction notice is served. For notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27 the payment is $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; $24,733.00 max per unit; +$5,497.00 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren) (notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27)
rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.coverage_text: Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work OR Substantial Rehabilitation; additional amount for each elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren).
rules.exemptions: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9, not Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.interaction: For temporary capital improvement evictions lasting less than 20 days, state law (Cal. Civ. Code 1947.9) governs relocation amounts instead of the local ordinance.
rules.extraction_note: Document is a rate archive table, not ordinance text. effective_date reflects the start of the current rate period (notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27); the table begins 8/10/06. The document also lists separate Ellis Act relocation amounts (notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27: $11,110.05 per tenant, $33,330.13 max per unit, +$7,443.90 per elderly (62+) or disabled tenant), but no full sentence in the document supports a separate quoted record, so it is noted here only.
